name: Project Kiki: Domesticated
source:
Welcome to Planet Kikilisia.
Deep in space, on the distant planet of Kikilisia, you find yourself at the mercy of three powerful women.
Which path will you choose during your re-education?
The Good Boy: Swallow your Elvarian pride, accept your new reality, and obey every command.
The Bad Boy: Fight back. Cling to your warrior instincts, break their rules, and resist their control at every turn.
Will you be a good boy and let them domesticate you?
